notes.md: - **AP One app (September 2026):** a single mobile app of the **Real Time Governance Society (RTGS)** for about **150 government services**, in Telugu and English (certificates can be downloaded). The earlier **Mana Mitra** WhatsApp Governance platform was launched on **30 January 2025**.

- **CM and Council of Ministers (status in the period):** **N. Chandrababu Naidu** was sworn in as Chief Minister for the **fourth time** on **12 June 2024** at **Kesarapalli** (near Vijayawada airport, Gannavaram); Governor **S. Abdul Nazeer** gave the oath; **24 ministers** were sworn in with him; **Pawan Kalyan** (Jana Sena) is **Deputy CM**.
- **Capital (status in the period):** **Amaravati** is the capital under the **AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026** (**Act 7 of 2026**), with effect from **2 June 2024**.

- **Cabinet of 26 March 2026:** chaired by CM **N. Chandrababu Naidu**; approved the resolution to name Amaravati in **Section 5** of the 2014 Act, and **96 new courts** with **1,730 posts** (first phase, to cut the pendency of cases).

- **December 2025 pensions:** NTR Bharosa pensions were paid **a day early, on 31 December 2025**, as a New Year gesture – about **₹2,743 crore** to about **63 lakh** beneficiaries; over **₹50,000 crore** had been spent on pensions since the government took office in June 2024.

- **NTR Bharosa pension rates (from July 2024):** **₹4,000** a month for the aged, widows, weavers, single women, fishermen and transgender persons; **₹6,000** for persons with disabilities; **₹15,000** for the fully disabled; **₹10,000** for dialysis (kidney) patients. The first enhanced payment (1 July 2024) went to about **65 lakh** beneficiaries.
- **Spouse pensions (May 2025):** **71,380** spouses of deceased pensioners were approved under the **spouse category**; each gets **₹4,000** a month, from the month after the pensioner's death.
